description: Sizes a USDA Section 538 loan the way the site's loan sizer does: the 90% (for-profit) or 97% (nonprofit or public) cap on the lower of cost or value against the DSCR cap (1.15x default), with NOI, debt service, loan-to-cost and the 2026 guarantee fees. Arithmetic on your inputs, not a quote.

dscr.description: Minimum DSCR (default 1.15; 1.11 for the first 200 preservation pilot loans).

fee_category.description: standard = 65 bp initial / 35 bp annual; reduced = 60 / 25 (workforce, 515 preservation or Opportunity Zone).

interest_rate_pct.description: Your lender's quoted fixed rate in percent, e.g. 6.25.

opex_per_unit_year.description: Operating expenses per unit per year incl. taxes, insurance, management and reserves.

other_income_per_unit_month.description: Other income per unit per month (default 0).

rent_per_unit_month.description: Average rent per unit per month in dollars.

vacancy_pct.description: Vacancy and collection loss on rent, percent (default 5).

name: size_538_loan
title: Size a Section 538 guaranteed loan
